blocks.text: Pedro Taduran remained king of the minimumweight division after turning back unbeaten Spanish challenger Brandon Moreno via unanimous decision to successfully defend his International Boxing Federation (IBF) world title for the fourth consecutive time on Sunday, November 8, at the Kiva Auditorium in Albuquerque, New Mexico....
